title: Scattered information. Shared intelligence.
body: Over the past two years, I’ve built and maintained shared information systems for a growing B2B business. They support the team’s everyday work.
detail: Built from the ground up. Kept useful every day. I took ownership of bringing scattered information together and keeping it current, so colleagues could find answers, access reporting, and move work forward.

sections.label: THE CHALLENGE
sections.copy: As the business grew, valuable information became harder to keep in view. The team needed a dependable way to get the context behind its work.

sections.label: MY CONTRIBUTION
sections.copy: I built most of the system from the ground up. My contribution continues beyond the initial build: timely updates, ongoing improvements, and making sure the information people need is ready when they need it.

sections.label: THE DIFFERENCE
sections.copy: The team has current information and reporting at its fingertips. Colleagues can work asynchronously, and new team members have shared context to get started. A small team can stay on top of more.

sections.label: ABOUT THIS CASE STUDY
sections.copy: This summary describes my contribution at a high level. Internal implementation details remain private.
